phases.message: Inspections are slipping on both cities' jobs. Start here in Permitway: Ashford's rules on requests, sequence, re-inspections and its calendar, and every inspection on our permits.
Now Civicdesk for Merrow: their policies, and every inspection on each of our permits there.
This is Sitegrid. What's actually complete and ready on each job, and where the corrections stand.
And the crew calendar for next week: who's on site where, and when.
Back in Permitway. Request every Ashford inspection that's ready, on the first day it can actually happen. Leave anything that isn't ready or in sequence.
Now Civicdesk. Schedule every Merrow inspection that's ready, on the first day it can happen. Then tell me what you left alone in both cities and why.

pw_rules.text: Today is Friday 9 October 2026, 10:40. Permitway, City of Ashford Building Division. Ashford has adopted the International Building Code, chapter 1, section 110 (inspections), with its own amendments. Topics: requests, sequence, reinspection, calendar. One request per inspection.

Request an inspection when the work is ready for it (IBC 110.5). Requests made before 3:00 pm are scheduled for the next day the City inspects; later requests for the day after. Choose the date: any inspection day on or after the earliest one, when the work is ready and the contractor's site contact is there to meet the inspector. An inspection already scheduled or passed is not requested again.

Work is not covered or carried past an inspection point until that inspection is approved (IBC 110.6). The footing inspection comes before concrete is placed and before the foundation inspection. The framing inspection is requested only after the rough plumbing, rough electrical, rough mechanical and gas piping inspections are all approved (IBC 110.3.4). Insulation follows an approved framing inspection and the insulation in place; the final follows every other inspection on the permit.

A failed inspection is requested again on the same inspection id once every correction listed is complete. A re-inspection requested before the corrections are done is charged the re-inspection fee and fails again.
Ashford inspects Monday to Friday. City holidays, with no inspections: Monday 12 October 2026 (Indigenous Peoples' Day), Wednesday 11 November, Thursday 26 and Friday 27 November.

cd_policies.text: Today is Friday 9 October 2026, 10:40. Civicdesk, City of Merrow Development Services. Merrow has adopted the International Building Code, section 110, and issues separate building, plumbing and electrical permits. Topics: scheduling, order, corrections. Schedule each inspection on its own permit.

Schedule an inspection when the work is complete and ready (IBC 110.5). Requests in by 3:00 pm are inspected the next business day; Merrow inspects Monday to Friday and is open on Monday 12 October. Give a date on or after the earliest one when the work is ready and your on-site contact is there. Each permit's inspections are scheduled on that permit; a trade permit's final does not wait on the building permit's final. Do not schedule an inspection already passed or already scheduled.

Nothing is covered until it is approved (IBC 110.6). On a slab, the slab pre-pour inspection (vapor retarder and reinforcement) is scheduled only after the under-slab plumbing and the under-slab electrical inspections are both approved.

A failed inspection is scheduled again only once its corrections are complete; the request certifies that they are. A re-inspection scheduled before then is a false certification and carries the $95 re-inspection fee.
